Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan had a forgetful time with the ball. Mohammad Amir began well but could not do much post that. The tactics from Pakistan were weird as they looked to keep India down with their spinners and didn't quite use the conditions on offer. Imad Wasim and Wahab Riaz were hit around the park and the target of 324 looks a tall order now. The rain needs to stop for us to get the chase going though. Stay tuned for the updates.

The rain breaks did not help India as it came at intervals to stall their momentum. The two Indian openers set the platform for them with a 136-run stand. Both Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma missed out on their tons. Virat Kohli anchored the innings and it was his 93-run stand with Yuvraj Singh that gave India the par score that they have. Both were dropped earlier and they made them pay scoring fifties.

Magnificent finish from India. The Pakistan fielders walking off with their heads down shows how badly they lost the plot towards the end. India plundered 72 runs in the last four overs to finish with a par score on the board. Expect DLS to increase the target for Pakistan too as India did not lose too many wickets.

FOUR! Kohli finishes it off in style! Full outside off, Kohli extends his arms and smashes it over extra cover. Gets it into the gap there and the ball crosses the fence on a couple of bounces. INDIA FINISH ON 319/3!
Full outside off, this time Pandya mistimes his loft towards long off. A single taken.
Sarfraz is complaining about the rain now. Cheeky but not sure if the umpires are going to agree to it since there are just two balls left.

NOT OUT! Decision stays! Imad drags his length back a touch, Pandya gets across, kneels down and looks to heave it on the on side but misses. Gets rapped near the waist region and the players appeal for lbw, but it's turned down. Sarfraz straightaway goes for the review. Snicko doesn't detect any edge and Hawk Eye shows that the ball would have gone on to clip the top of the stumps. So, it's the umpire's call and Pandya survives.
There is an lbw appeal against Hardik Pandya. Pakistan review. Looks not out.
SIX! Hat-trick of maximums! Pandya expecting the ball to slide in, gets across and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Pandya is on fire. Can he make it six in six?
SIX! Another one! Once again Wasim fires it full outside off and Pandya smashes it over long off for another half a dozen. Can he keep it going?
SIX! Pandya power! Full outside off, Pandya bends his back knee and tonks it over long off for a maximum. That was a clean hit!
The batsman just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler.
SIX! That's some shot! Full outside off and Kohli lofts it over extra cover for a biggie. That was struck beautifully. Kohli has got back in his elements now.
FOUR! Creamed! Very full around off, Kohli just creams it over extra cover for a boundary. Now Pakistan would be ruing their dropped chance!
Very full around off, jammed out to covers for a single.
Hardik Pandya strides out to bat.

OUT! Decision overturned! Plumb! Almost a yorker in the line of the stumps, Yuvraj fails to dig it out and gets hit low on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. After a discussion with his bowler, Sarfraz takes the review. There was a slight noise of bat being involved. It was of the bat being hit on the ground as shown by the Hot Spot. The Snicko doesn't detect any edge and the Hawk Eye shows that Yuvraj was plumb. The dangerous southpaw has to depart. End of the 93-run stand off 58 balls.
There is a loud shout against Yuvraj for an lbw. Sarfraz goes for the review. Looks close.
Yuvraj covers his stumps, Hasan bowls a full toss outside off, driven to covers.
Bowls it too full and wide outside off, Kohli lets it go thinking it will be a wide but it was well inside the tramline.
Now Riaz is getting some attention on his right leg. Even he is going off the field. Pakistan in all kinds of trouble. IMAD WASIM to complete his over now.
Shorter again outside off, Yuvraj backs away and looks to go over the off side but miscues it to third man for a single. Riaz is down now, struggling with his ankle.
52nd ODI fifty for Yuvraj Singh!

FOUR! Top edged! Shorter in length on the stumps, Yuvraj looks to pull but gets a top edge over the head of the keeper for a boundary. That is a fifty for him, in just 29 balls. And not to forget, he was dropped on 8.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli this time angles it to third man for a single.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Kohli into an overdrive! Length ball on the stumps, Kohli gets under it and just launches it over long on for a maximum. What a strike.
Sarfraz has a word with his bowler. Not for the first time today.
FOUR! Thumped! Riaz bowls it around off and middle, Kohli gets under it and just whips it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. He has picked up pace now.
Free Hit time!
FOUR! Wahab sprays it wide outside off, Kohli gets a bat to it and gets it down to third man for a boundary. To make matters worse, it is a no ball for overstepping.
FOUR! Full toss and put away! It's angling in and Yuvraj tonks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 17 runs off the over. India are just cruising at the moment.
Full around off, jammed through covers for a single.
40th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli.

SIX! Kohli is delighted! That came off the meat. Cutter on the shorter side. Kohli goes back and pulls it over long on for a maximum. Gets to his fifty and pumps his fist to remove all his frustration.
Wide yorker around off, dug out to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Full toss in the line of the stumps, Yuvraj plays a short hand jab over mid on for a boundary. This is a Yuvi special!
Full toss on middle, Kohli mistimes his loft towards mid on for a single.

DROPPED! Back of a length delivery, angling away, Kohli goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The substitute Fahim Ashraf at deep mid-wicket, sprints ahead, slides in to catch. Gets his hands to it but ends up spilling it. Another drop in the field by Pakistan. And this time it's of the Indian skipper! A single is taken.
Fuller length delivery, whipped but straight to mid-wicket.
Yuvraj makes room, Riaz sees that and bowls a cutter on the shorter side. Yuvraj mistimes it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, Kohli moves across just a touch and drives it to long on for a single.
Short and angling in, Yuvraj mistimes his pull. The ball falls between the two converging fielders at deep mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Oh dear! Amir is down. He seems to have hurt himself and is getting some medical attention. He is walking off the field and WAHAB RIAZ to complete the over.
Leg bye! Length delivery around leg, Kohli looks to flick it away but gets beaten by pace. The ball goes off the pads on the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
50-run stand between Kohli and Yuvraj.
SIX! Into the stands! Short delivery and Yuvraj latches onto it in a flash. Pulls it over backward square leg for a huge biggie. He is playing a gem of a cameo. 12 runs off the over!
Yuvraj shimmies across slightly, Ali bowls a full delivery wide outside off. Singh fails to put it away.
FOUR! That's hit hard!  Full outside off, Yuvraj smashes it past his partner. Even the long off fielder can't cut it off with a dive. That's a smashing hit!
Another yorker around off, jammed to backward point for a single.
Kohli makes room and Hasan bowls a clever wide yorker. It's too good for the Indian skipper and he fails to put bat on the ball.
Low full toss around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Yuvraj makes slight room, Amir follows him with a near yorker. Squeezed through behind point for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Slower short delivery, pulled past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. That's classic from Yuvi!
Full toss outside off, Kohli mistimes it to mid off for a single. Can you believe it? Kohli has mistimed a full toss.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery around middle and leg, driven through mid on for a single.
Slight hesitation! Full around leg, Kohli makes room and drives it to mid off. Yuvraj from the other end takes off but is sent back rightly by Kohli.
Mohammad Amir called back on for a bowl.
Back of a length delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish length delivery, angling in, punched to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Lucky! Hasan nearly got rid of Yuvraj there! He bowls a superb yorker outside off, the southpaw digs it out at the very last moment. Gets a bottom edge and the ball whiskers past the off pole. Beats Sarfraz and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli hits it off the higher part of the bat through covers for a single.
On a length outside off, punched to backward point.
Shorter length delivery, angling in, Kohli drags it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Hasan Ali comes back on for a bowl.
FOUR! Crunched! Slower delivery outside off, Yuvraj picks it up and spanks it through covers for a boundary. Riaz has proved to be very expensive today.
Quick bumper from Riaz. Singh gets out of its way.
Shorter outside off, Yuvraj cuts it into the ground and the ball races towards point. Shadab at backward point, leaps to his right and makes a superb stop.
Short and wide outside off, Singh cuts it past backward point. The outfield is sluggish and the ball won't make it to the fence. A brace is taken.
On a back of a length outside off, defended towards backward point.
Angling away from Kohli, run down to third man for a single.
Powerplay 3 signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.
Googly around leg, defended to mid-wicket.
Leg spinner around middle and leg, Kohli goes back and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a single.

DROPPED! Googly around off, Yuvraj dances down and looks to loft it down the ground. He fails to make a proper connection and ends up mistiming it over mid off. Hasan Ali at long off, gets under the ball catches it but as he slides, spills the ball down. Oh dear, this can prove very costly to Pakistan. A single is taken off the drop.
Leg break on middle, Kohli goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Shadab serves it wide outside off, Yuvraj extends his arms and drives it through covers for a single.
Wrong 'un around off, dabbed to backward point.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, pulled through square leg for a single.

FOUR! After going short, Riaz goes for the yorker around off. Misses his length by a touch and Yuvraj flicks it through mid-wicket. Wasim tries to chase it down but comes second to the ball. A boundary will boost Yuvi's confidence!
Banged in short outside off, Yuvraj sways away from it.
Angling away from the right-hander, guided to third man for a single.
Short from Riaz, Yuvraj rises and taps it on the off side for a quick single. The shy at the bowler's end misses and a single is completed.
Slanting away from Kohli, pushed with the angle in covers for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed delivery, knocked down to long on for a single to get off the mark.
Yuvraj Singh walks out to bat. India need him to play a cameo here to get them to a par score.

OUT! Run out! Rohit failed to ground his bat there. Kohli strides forward and plays it with soft hands square of the wicket on the off side. Sharma takes off from the other end for a quick risky single. Azam from point gets to the ball and throws it quickly to his keeper who whips off the bails. Rohit Sharma puts in a desperate dive but his bat seems to be in air. The umpire goes upstairs and the replay shows that as Rohit dived, his bat was in the air. This is a big wicket for Pakistan.
There is a run out appeal at the striker's end and Rohit looks to be in danger.
Another leg break on middle, Sharma punches it through wide mid on for a single.
Leg spinner around off, dabbed towards short third man for a quick single. Kohli appreciates his partner for calling for the quick run.
Tossed up around off, whipped off the front foot to long on for a single.
And.....the drizzle is back. Been such a day.
Length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single.
50-run stand between Kohli and Rohit.
SIX! Hammered! Riaz goes short this time. Rohit latches onto it in a flash as though he expected it and pulls it over square leg for a maximum. He is gaining his momentum back.
FOUR! Class! Fuller length delivery outside off, Rohit stands tall and drives it on the up through the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary. Superb shot!
Length delivery, angling away, Kohli guides it to third man for a single.
Angling away from Sharma, he looks to drive with the angle but gets an outside edge and the ball goes to third man. A single taken.
Beaten! Back of a length, angling away, Sharma looks to glide it on the off side but misses. The replay shows that Riaz's towel fell when he was about to deliver.
Wahab Riaz asked to come back on. This is a good period of play for Pakistan.
Leg spinner outside off, Kohli leaves it alone.
Tossed up around off, driven nicely but straight to covers.
Served outside off, spinning away, dabbed to short third man.
Once again Shadab bowls on a shorter length. Kohli goes back and punches it through backward square leg for a brace.
Leg spinner on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Leg break on the shorter side, Kohli looks to punch it off the back foot but the away spin catches an outside edge and goes to Riaz at short third man.
Shadab Khan recalled into the attack.

CHANCE! Length delivery, angling away, Rohit dabs it behind point and takes off for a quick single but is sent back as Shadab rushes to the ball. There's a shy at the striker's end but misses and the Indian opener has to dive back. Just one from the over!
Slight delay as Rohit has a problem with the sightscreen again.
Another cutter, played with gentle hands in the point region.
Cutter on middle and leg, defended from within the crease.
Slanting away from Sharma, he taps it off the front foot to backward point.
Short and angling away, glided to third man for a single.
Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma are back out in the middle. Mohammad Amir to complete his over. Let's hope the weather does not disturb us now.

Update 1413 local time - And the drizzle has stopped again. The covers are being taken off. We might have just lost an over here, yup, it is a 48-OVER game now. Two bowlers can bowl 9 overs, 3 bowlers can bowl 10 overs. Powerplay 1 (1-10), Powerplay 2 (11-39), Powerplay 3 (40-48).
Update 1406 local time - Scratch that update. The rain is back and the players have to head back to the dressing rooms. Not a good sight. Hope that this is a passing shower.
Update 1350 local time - The rain has stopped and the umpires are done inspecting. They are happy with  the situation and the game will RESUME AT 1410 LOCAL TIME. It will be a 49-OVER game.

Update 1332 local time - Oh dear, the rain has come down harder and the players are going off the field. India will not mind the break now, Rohit was not finding the middle of the bat and Pakistan had conceded just 15 runs in the last five overs. The break will do them good. But let's hope that the rain clears up soon like before and we get the game going.
On a length and angling away, Kohli strides forward and leaves it alone.
The two umpires come together for a chat about the rain.
Short and angling in, Kohli stands tall and taps it towards square leg for a single.
Banged in short, angling in, Kohli looks to hook but the bumper is too good for him and he eventually ducks under it.
On a length and outside off, Rohit looks to glide it on the off side but gets a bottom edge just behind the wicket. Kohli takes off from the other end and completes a quick single.
Length delivery outside off, Rohit looks to pull but mistimes it to short mid-wicket. It wasn't that short to pull.
The drizzle is back.
On a length outside off at 141 kph. Sharma defends it watchfully.
Length delivery outside off, Sharma looks to cut it but ends up chopping it to point.
Drinks time!
FOUR! Up and over! Short and angling away, Kohli makes full use of the width on offer and cuts it over backward point for a boundary. Good way to end the over.
Full in the line of the stumps, turned wide of mid on for a single.
Very full on middle, Sharma looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge to short cover. That nearly got the better of the Indian opener.
Length delivery, angling away, glides it past point for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Sharma guides it to third man for a single. That was hit in the air.
Kohli shimmies across a touch and flicks it to the right of mid on for a single.
Well-directed bouncer! Takes Rohit by surprise, who gets away at the last moment. Just a run from the over. This is good, tidy stuff from Pakistan. They are chipping in with some tight overs.
Ali pulls his length back a touch. Rohit looks to pull it down the ground but gets it off the higher part of the bat. Is lucky that the ball falls short of Imad at mid on.
Again Hasan keeps it on a length outside off. Rohit looks to defend with a straight bat but gets a bottom edge onto the pads.
Length delivery, nips in a touch after pitching. Kohli gets across and works it with soft hands in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full on middle and off, Kohli shimmies just a touch and drives it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli makes a watchful leave.
Pace from both ends now as Hasan Ali is brought back into the attack!
On a good length and angling away, dabbed towards point.
Good shot but straight to the fielder! Slanting away from Sharma, he drives it crisply on the up but finds Hafeez at cover.
Length outside off, left alone again. Rohit being very watchful here!
Back of a length outside off, slanting away, Rohit covers the stumps and lets it go.
Length delivery, angling away, run down to third man for a single.
A touch ahead of length, angling away, defended off the front foot.
Mohammad Amir is back on. There's a wide slip in place. This is a good attacking move from Sarfraz!
Fuller one on middle and off, Kohli drives it through mid on for a single.
Googly outside off, Kohli fails to pick it. Leans ahead to play for the spin but gets an inside edge on the leg side.
Leg break on the shorter side, Rohit goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, Sharma leans ahead and defends it to short cover.
Kohli goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, knocked through mid off for a single.
Good running! Fuller delivery around off, Kohli drives it through wide mid off. Till the time the long off fielder cuts it off, the batsmen pick up a brace.
Rohit goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Full on middle, driven through mid off for a single.
FOUR! Deft! Straighter delivery outside off, Virat Kohli crouches low, lets the ball to come to him and then opens the face of the bat to guide it fine to the third man fence. Superb batting!
Sliding into the batsmen, eased down to long on for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single.

Run out chance! Tossed up around off, Kohli prods forward and defends it on the off side with soft hands. Takes off for a single and Rohit obliges. Imad at short cover is slow to take off and his throw at the striker's end is also a wild one. A direct hit would have been very close! Rohit survives and a single is completed.
Slightly shorter this time, Sharma waits for the ball to come to him and then punches it through covers for a single.
Leg break outside off, Kohli strides forward and pushes it through covers for a single.
Short third man moves to short cover.
Tossed up again on off, driven to long on for a single.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, milked down to long off for a single.
Served around leg, Rohit prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Rohit dances down, Imad spots that and fires it into his legs. The Indian opener does well to flick it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sliding in from around middle and off, clipped with the angle in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Slower through the air outside off, spinning away, dabbed to point.
Slides it into Kohli, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to point.
Fuller on leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Imad Wasim returns for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, Rohit cuts it to the deep point fielder for a single.
Shorter outside off, Kohli goes back and punches it wide of the bowler for a single.
Bowls it on middle, the wrong one, Kohli comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner half towards the leg side.
Virat Kohli is the new man in. He has got a superb platform to make full use of. There is still a slight drizzle in the air though.

OUT! Picked out the fielder! Shadab bowls it on the stumps, it's a full toss, Dhawan comes down and looks to go big over mid-wicket. He though finds the fielder Azhar Ali in the deep and that is the breakthrough for Pakistan. Dhawan departs after a good knock though.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan comes down the wicket and hits it back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, Rohit comes forward and pushes it towards point for a single.
Floats it on off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Brilliant batting! Fuller on the stumps, Dhawan gets outside the line and sweeps it fine to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller outside leg, Rohit clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, Rohit turns it towards short mid-wicket from his crease. Dhawan wants a single but is sent back.
Flatter on middle, Dhawan comes down and hits it in the air wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Shorter on middle, Dhawan arches back and punches it to covers for a single.
Dhawan comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floats it outside off, the wrong one, Rohit looks to defend but gets it off the inside edge through square leg for a single.
Lands it outside leg, turned through mid on for a single.
Too full outside off, Dhawan pushes it back down the wicket.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rohit drives it through mid on for a single.
Lands it outside leg, turned through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter around off, Rohit punches it towards covers.
Fuller around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller just outside off, pushed towards covers by the batsman.
Fuller on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it in line of the stumps, Dhawan turns it towards short fine leg for a single.
Shoaib Malik comes on for a bowl.
Driven nicely through covers for a couple of runs.
Rohit defends it watchfully to point from his crease.
Darts it on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it on middle, spins away, Rohit defends it towards covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan drives it through mid off for a single.
SIX! Brilliant shot! Fuller on middle, Dhawan comes down the track and just clobbers it over mid-wicket for a maximum. These two are going after the bowling now. That was the wrong one by Shadab.
Dhawan taps it towards point for a single.
18th ODI fifty for Shikhar Dhawan!

Played, Dhawan! Fuller outside off, slower in pace, Dhawan drives it through point. There is a fumble and it allows him to take a couple of runs. Dhawan too gets to his fifty. There has been a lot of talk about his place but he has just shown how good an ODI player he is.
FOUR! BOOM! Short and wide outside off, Dhawan spanks it over the point region for a boundary. The boundaries are starting to flow now for India.
Sarfraz has a word with his bowler. A very animated chat, that.
FOUR! Poor line and punished! Fuller on the pads, Dhawan clips it through the fine leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Flashed! Shorter in length just outside off, Dhawan waits for it and just flashes at it. He gets it down to third man for a boundary.
Back of a length just around off, Dhawan taps it towards the off side and wants a single but is sent back.
Floats it outside off, Rohit comes forward and defends it.
30th ODI fifty for Rohit Sharma!
SIX! Played, Rohit! Shadab drops it short just around off, Rohit goes back and pumps it over mid-wicket for a biggie. He was out from the game for sometime but has announced his arrival in England.
Loops it outside off, Rohit defends it watchfully.

Top edged! Lands it outside off, Rohit looks to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. Hasan Ali looks to get to it from long on but the ball falls in the vacant mid-wicket region. A couple taken. The leg spinners have had a good time against Rohit in recent times.
Lands it just outside off, Rohit hits it back down the wicket to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, Rohit looks to take a single with a half pull but the bowler goes to his right and dives to stop the ball.
Shorter length just outside off, gets big on Dhawan who looks to angle it to third man. Ends up getting it towards point from his crease.
Good length outside off, Rohit taps it towards covers for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan drives it towards extra cover who gets a hand to it. The mid off fielder cuts it off and a single is taken.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Rohit pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Outside off on a length, played with an angled bat to point.
Fuller outside off, Rohit gets it towards point from his crease.
Shorter just outside off, Rohit punches it towards long on for a single. The bowler tried to stop it with a dive to his right but could not do so.
Lands it outside off, Rohit plays it with the spin towards the off side. Wants a single but is sent back.
Bowls it on the stumps, Dhawan turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Too full outside off, driven to deep point for a single.
Shorter in length again, Dhawan drags it through square leg for a single.
Drops it short outside off, Rohit taps it towards short third man for a quick single.
Time for some leg spin, Shadab Khan comes into the attack.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and wide outside off, Dhawan gets under it and ramps it over point for a boundary. That is a shot in confidence by Shikhar. He loves to go over the off side.
Once again it has gone dark out there. Oh dear, it has started raining as well!
WIDE! Slips one down the leg side on a fuller length. Wide signaled.
Shorter outside off, Rohit dabs it to third man for a single. Good work by Hasan Ali in the deep.
FOUR! Up and over! Slants it fuller and outside off, Rohit gets under it and drives it on the up over mid off for a boundary.

Fuller on the stumps again, clipped through backward square leg for a single. Dhawan wants the second but Rohit slips as the throw comes in. The keeper gets to the stumps and looks to deflect it onto the stumps but misses. That could have been close.
Good length on off, Rohit tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Almost a return catch! Fuller on the stumps, Dhawan looks to clip it but gets a leading edge just wide of the bowler. A single taken.
Hurls it on a length on off, Dhawan turns it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. He wanted the second but is sent back.
Looks like the bowler has been given a warning for following through on the danger area on the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Rohit drives it through covers for a single.
Good length wide outside off, left alone by Rohit.
Shorter outside off, Rohit looks to cut it through point but Shadab dives to his right and stops the ball. Saved a certain boundary there.
Good length on off, Rohit works it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. That was well run.
Fuller just outside off, Rohit gets in line and defends it.
Sprays it wide outside off, Rohit crashes it to deep point for a single. That was hit really hard. Good work by Shehzad in the deep.
Dhawan works this one neatly into the leg side for a single.
A tad short but on the pads, tucked towards fine leg for a single.
Sprays it wide outside off, Rohit goes after the width but fails to connect. Sharma will feel he should have connected there.
Good length just outside off, Rohit defends it towards point from his crease.
Fuller and outside off, Rohit lets it go through.
Finally Imad Wasim taken off. Wahab Riaz introduced into the attack. He will want to bowl a fiery spell here.
Shorter in length around off, Dhawan gets out of the way in time to let it through.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Rohit turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Once again Rohit is having some problem with the sightscreen. Also, a light drizzle has started.
Nice ball! Shorter in length just outside off, Rohit lets it go through watchfully. He was looking to ride the bounce and play but left it at the end.
Fuller and outside leg, Dhawan looks to clip it but gets it off his pads towards the leg side for a leg bye.
A tad short just outside off, Dhawan angles it past the diving Shadab Khan at backward point for a couple of runs. He went the wrong way at first and hence could not stop it.
Lands it on a length, Dhawan comes down the wicket and taps it towards cover.
Fuller outside off, Rohit drives it towards cover.
A touch short outside off, keeps a touch low, Rohit counters it well and keeps it out. That was bowled at 103 kph!
Full outside off, Rohit pushes it to covers.
Flatter on the pads, Dhawan clips it through square leg for a single.
Fuller around off, pushed wide of extra cover for a single.
Fuller around off, Dhawan clips it through mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, Rohit mistimes his cut towards point.
Hurls it outside off on a length, comes in a touch, Rohit lets it go through.

FOUR! Low full toss outside off, Rohit gets under it and launches it over mid on for a boundary. He has made full use of the Free Hit. Hasan didn't get his yorker right there. 50 up for India, this is a good start for them.
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! Fuller and angling around off, Rohit pushes it towards mid on from his crease. But unfortunately, he has overstepped and it is signaled a no ball.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan drives it through covers for a single.
A touch short around off, Dhawan taps it towards covers from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it.
Hasan Ali to continue from the other end.
The umpire signals the start of Powerplay 2. Four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the 40th over.
Floats it outside off, Rohit comes forward and defends it.

The players are back out in the middle for the game. The two Indian openers will hope to build on this start. Imad Wasim to complete his over. There is a spot on the sightscreen which is troubling Rohit. All set though now.
Update 1145 local time - GOOD NEWS! The rain has relented and the covers are coming off. Play will resume at 1200 local time. No overs lost for now.

Update 1110 local time - The rain looks to have settled. India would be disappointed with the proceedings as they were just starting to open up. Pakistan won't mind it at all. We will have the next update at 1215 local time. Stay tuned...

Update 1108 local time - Oh dear! As expected the rains have arrived and the players are going off. There was rain forecast and it has not let itself down. Let's hope it clears up soon and we are back on the field as early as possible. Stay tuned for more updates.
Dhawan comes forward and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
In the air but safe... Fuller on middle, Rohit looks to drive but gets it in the air towards square leg for a single. He actually got an inside edge there.
It has started drizzling at Edgbaston! Not good signs these as the match was going along nicely.
Close! Flatter just outside off, Rohit looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. That was bowled at 102 kph.

Dhawan works it through mid-wicket for a single. There is a wild throw at the striker's end and it results in an overthrow. Shehzad does not back up well and they get an extra couple. Poor work and the Pakistan skipper is not impressed.
FOUR! Tonked! Fires it just outside off, Dhawan sits low and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Could be the sign of things to come now.
Hurls it outside off, left alone by Rohit.
Good length outside off, Rohit looks to drag it through mid-wicket but misses. That wasn't that short and was too wide as well.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter outside off, Rohit rides the bounce and gets it past the diving point fielder for a boundary. Superb shot, that.
Drifts on the pads, Dhawan works it through backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length just around off, Dhawan defends it back down the wicket.
Good length on off, Dhawan taps it towards point from his crease.
Hasan Ali called on for a bowl. He has impressive variations in pace and could be handy on this wicket.
Lands it outside off, driven nicely to covers by Rohit.
Rohit comes forward and pushes it to mid off.

What happened there? Dhawan taps it to mid off and takes off. Rohit was ball-watching and is slow to take off. The throw from Riaz comes in at the striker's end but hits Rohit. The keeper, Sarfraz appeals for obstructing the field but then aborts it rightly.

Shorter outside off, Dhawan waits for it and cuts it through point. Babar Azam hares after it from covers and keeps the ball in play with a slide near the fence. Shehzad again fumbled at point. Two runs taken.
Sarfraz has a word with his bowler.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped to long on for a single.
Flatter outside leg, Dhawan comes down the wicket and turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Lands it on a length, Dhawan pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Shorter in length just around off, Dhawan defends it back down the wicket.
Works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Interesting. India have the lowest run rate in the first Powerplay in ODIs since ICC Cricket World Cup 2015. Maybe they are being too cautious?
A tad short in length, Rohit turns it towards mid-wicket.
Much tighter in line, on off, Rohit defends it watchfully.

FOUR! Just wide! Slants it outside off, Rohit looks to guide it square of the wicket but gets an outside edge which flies just wide of the first slip. Azhar dives to his right but cannot get a hand to it. A boundary for Rohit.
Drops it short just outside off, Dhawan chops it towards covers.
Rohit angles it towards short third man for a quick single.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Shorter outside off, Rohit stays back and punches it on the up past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Dhawan taps this one to covers for a quick single.
Lands it outside off, Dhawan comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Bowls it around off, Dhawan turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Shorter outside off, guided to point by Rohit. Amir has bowled well here.
Full and going across Rohit, he lets it go through happily.
Dhawan looks to drive this one through the off side but gets it off the inside edge through backward square leg for a single.
A tad short just around off, Rohit rides the bounce and keeps it down towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Top edged! Shorter in length and with the fine leg up, Rohit was always going to go for the pull. He is a good puller of the ball but he gets it of the top edge over short fine leg for a boundary.
Slants it on the stumps, Rohit turns it towards the leg side from his crease. He wants a single but is sent back as Amir gets to the ball quickly.
Flatter on middle, Rohit drives it towards mid off and takes off for a single. Malik scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Rohit had got in.
Fuller on middle, Rohit turns it towards the on side.
Dhawan turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Dhawan turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Shorter outside off, Rohit works it through mid on for a single.
Flatter on middle, Dhawan works it through mid on for a single.
Full again, just outside off, Rohit comes forward and defends it. Another good over by Amir. This is a sedate start from India.
Shorter in length just outside off, Rohit punches it towards covers from his crease.
Slants it on a fuller length, Rohit gets in line and defends it. No movement for Amir.
Drifts it on the pads, Rohit tucks it towards mid-wicket from his crease.

Full outside off, Rohit drives it through covers for a couple of runs. That was well timed by him. Shadab looked to chase it from extra cover but when he was collecting he slipped and so did Malik coming from mid off.
Fuller around off, Rohit comes forward and pushes it towards point with an open face of the bat.
Looks to turn it through the leg side but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Dhawan punches it towards covers from his crease.
Slants it outside off, Dhawan punches it to covers. He wants a change of bat.
Lands it on middle and leg, Dhawan turns it towards mid-wicket and wants a single but is sent back.
Fires it on off, Dhawan plays it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Darts it down the leg side, Dhawan looks to put it away but missed. A wide is signaled.
Shorter outside off, Dhawan gets across and dabs it towards point. The fielder at point fumbles and allows it through him. A couple of runs taken. Shehzad was the culprit there.
Okay, a surprise move from Pakistan. Imad Wasim to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Interesting.
Slants across a good length delivery, Rohit leaves it all alone. A maiden to begin with for Amir.
On a length just around off, Rohit looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. He wants a single but is sent back.
And again! Full and outside off, Rohit wants to drive it through covers but fails to put bat to ball. Nervy start for him.
This one is wide enough for a leave from Rohit.

This was how he bowled to Rohit in the World T20 2016 game as well. Hurls it fuller just around off, Rohit plays at it as he should. The ball bounces more and carries nicely to Sarfraz. Amir has a word to say to Rohit which amuses him.
BEATEN! Excellent start for Amir. Angles across a length ball just outside off, Rohit comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.

The atmosphere at the ground is nothing far from electric. There is a lot of drama in an India-Pakistan game always, one expects this game to breathe life into the tournament. The two Indian openers are Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. Pakistan begin with Mohammad Amir. Two slips in place for him. Here we go...
Time for the national anthems of both the countries. Always a proud moment!

The teams are out in the middle. There is a minute of silence to be observed for the people who lost their lives in the London attacks yesterday. It is often in time of grief that we look forward to the sport to provide relief and cheer people.
India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma, Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli(c), Yuvraj Singh, MS Dhoni (wk), Kedar Jadhav, Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Umesh Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Azhar Ali, Ahmed Shehzad, Mohammad Hafeez, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Sarfraz Ahmed (wk/c), Imad Wasim, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Wahab Riaz, Hasan Ali.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that it's not a bad thing to bat first in a big game and they will like to put some runs on board and add pressure on the opposition. Feels that the pitch is nice and hard and hopes that the fast bowlers come into play in the second innings. Adds that it's not about any particular individual, it's a team game. Mentions that the environment in the dressing room is pretty normal and there's not much pressure on them. Also says that they know this Pakistani side pretty well and have beaten them a couple of times in the past. Informs the five bowlers they are going with are Jasprit Bumrah, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Umesh Yadav, Hardik Pandya and Ravindra Jadeja.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed informs that they will bowl first. He hopes that the wicket won't change much. Feels that he will do well in the tournament. On the players confidence, he says that it is a pressure game and he hopes the players play freely. On his batting, he thinks that they will do well. Mentions that Fahim Ashraf is dropped for Shadab Khan.
TOSS - Pakistan win the toss and elect to field.

PITCH REPORT - Sourav Ganguly doing the report feels that it is a very good surface to bat. He opines that there isn't much moisture on the surface. He feels that spinners will come into play as there is a bit of rough on the surface.

Pakistan are coming into the game after a decent workout in the warm-up game against Bangladesh. While their match against Australia was washed out, they chased down a big score versus The Tigers. India were clinical in their warm-up games and will hope to continue the good work into the main tournament. It is going to be a pressure game and whoever holds their nerve, is likely to emerge victorious.

It's Sunday and we have India vs Pakistan lined up for you, can't get better, can it? Welcome to the coverage of the all-important fixture of the ICC Champions Trophy 2017. The ICC ensures we have this fixture in every global tournament for the fans. While the rivalry is maintained online and off the field but it looks to have subsided a touch on the cricket field.
